Sets how far a constraint may move. For a hinge the angle in degrees (from -180 to 180, 0 is the pose when it was made), for a slider the position in world units, for a distance constraint the smallest and the largest distance, for a cone constraint the half angle in degrees (the upper value). Point and fixed constraints have no limits.
@param constraint The constraint.
@param lower The lower limit.
@param upper The upper limit.
@gap The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
